artwork.prompt: Album cover artwork, square format. A 2020 sleeve deliberately styled after 1980-1999. Medium: duotone photograph printed over a flat solid colour block. Subject: a bare hedgerow against low white sky. Palette: desaturated ochre, moss green, bone white, overcast grey. Composition: photograph occupying two thirds, wide flat colour band, strong asymmetry. No text, lettering, typography, watermarks, logos or signatures anywhere in the image.
